ability.name: Gruesome Trophies
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks that target **^^Heroes^^** or **^^Monsters^^** made by friendly **^^Ogor Mawtribes^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Elixir of the Frostwyrm
ability.effect: Roll a dice. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

ability.name: The Fang of Ghur
ability.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
